svg.title: Idle, not built yet: the ground edge to edge and one line, no frame, 1024×600 at 1×, measured. Palette colours and live text as drawn; the magenta marks are measurements, not screen.

g.text: notBuilt.ground 0,0 1024×600 · panel, build notBuilt, fill ground, no rule, no edge (Idle only)
notBuilt.line 16,280 992×32 · the same region as on a framed screen
20 px medium, fog, centred on x 512, middle y 296
Idle, not built yet (props.idle on a screen with no Idle binding).
No top bar, no bottom line, no message plate, no ring:
the frame going away is what says Idle is on.
Comes after 60 s without a press, on any screen.
The first press sends wake and nothing else: back to the screen
under Idle, its frame as it was (180 ms dither, held).
Dock wakes, docks or lifts, and lands on Home.
